mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_hr_renewal_guard ( employee_id, scenario, status, action_id, task_id, version, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{employeeId}, #{scenario}, 'IDLE', null, null, 0, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_hr_renewal_guard set status = 'RESERVED', action_id = #{actionId}, task_id = null, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where employee_id = #{employeeId} and scenario = #{scenario} and status = 'IDLE' and action_id is null and task_id is null and version = #{expectedVersion} and not exists ( select 1 from sys_hr_lifecycle_action pending left join sys_hr_sign_event_outbox pending_o on pending_o.action_id = pending.action_id and pending_o.event_version = pending.version where pending.employee_id = #{employeeId} and pending.action_id <> #{actionId} and pending.action_type in ('RENEWAL_CONFIRMED', 'RENEWAL_DECLINED') and (pending_o.outbox_id is null or pending_o.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'SENDING', 'DEAD')) )
